title: docs(client): adjudicate the risk-dashboard lineage without merging it
intent: Record whether the February 22 risk-dashboard decomposition is a complete refactor of the February 19 implementation. Pin both clusters with mocked Axios, classify every difference, and stop before production edits.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds the lineage investigation, characterization tests for both risk clusters, an evidence test pinned in core CI, and a parking-lot entry. Production composables, both Vue dashboards, the router, and the Axios dependency are unchanged.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: PR #477 left the five risk files UNRESOLVED. This record compares request and response behavior, names RISK-L01 through RISK-L03, and withholds a canonical ruling until those gaps are ported. It does not delete either cluster.
